name: footer-status
title: Footer Status
description: Dense utility footer with a system status pill, a language switcher, a few links and copyright.

props.name: statusHref
props.description: Where the status pill links to.

props.name: defaultLanguage
props.description: Initially selected language code. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onLanguageChange
props.description: Called with the code of the language the visitor picks.

props.name: links
props.description: Small links in the bottom bar.

props.name: copyright
props.description: Text at the start of the bottom bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
